scripts.verify:harness: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run validate:data
scripts.validate:data: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js validate-data
scripts.validate:output: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js validate-output
scripts.route: npm run build && node --env-file-if-exists=.env dist/src/cli.js route-targets
scripts.route:samples: npm run build && node --env-file-if-exists=.env dist/src/cli.js route-samples
scripts.output:emit: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js emit-output
scripts.eval:seed: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js seed
scripts.eval:sample-seed: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js eval-sample-seed
scripts.runs:rebuild: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js rebuild-runs
